filter_note: V1 set (7) + market briefing + AI news; Today window ≈ Oct 3–5 PT (weekend + Monday morning)

market_briefing.lede: Enterprise agent platforms are starting to compete on spend caps and governed autonomy as much as on capability, while open speech and sovereign models keep lowering the cost of building on conversation data.

bullets.text: Agent budgets: Cohere North 2 (Oct 5) tracks token use per user and per agent, adds consumption tiers, company-wide caps and alerts, plus per-agent autonomy policies, shared agents and reusable skills.
Agent trust: OpenAI's safety-report lead David Robinson resigned Oct 3 calling the company's culture "broken"; OpenAI says it pauses training or holds back models when needed.
Conversation data: Google open-sourced DiarizationLM-Gemma-4-E4B (Oct 4, Apache-2.0), a 4B model that corrects speech-recognition and speaker-labeling output and runs locally.

biggest_ai_news.title: Cohere ships North 2 with token spending caps
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 5 — rebuilt agent orchestration with human sign-off steps, agent memory, skills, shared libraries; admin console caps token spend by user, group and company; model-agnostic, on-prem or VPC.

biggest_ai_news.title: OpenAI safety-report lead resigns, says culture is "broken"
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 3 — David Robinson's Atlantic essay cites rogue-agent incidents; OpenAI responds it pauses training or holds back models when needed.

biggest_ai_news.title: Aleph Alpha releases Kolibri open-weight model
biggest_ai_news.body: Available Oct 3, announced Oct 5 — 78B-parameter mixture-of-experts (~3B active), German/English, tool calling; Cohere merger still pending approval.

biggest_ai_news.title: Google open-sources DiarizationLM-Gemma-4-E4B
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 4 — 4B Apache-2.0 model that fixes ASR and speaker-diarization errors; quantized builds run locally.

what_changed.title: Cohere North 2 puts token caps and autonomy policies in the admin console
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent, not watchlist). Oct 5: North 2 rebuilds orchestration (multistep work with human sign-off), adds shareable prompt-built agents, cross-session memory, a skills feature and shared libraries. North Admin tracks token use per user and agent, sets consumption tiers and company caps with alerts, and applies PII/prompt-injection guardrails and per-agent autonomy policies. Connectors: Slack, GitHub, SharePoint, OneDrive. Why it matters: agent spend control is becoming a platform feature buyers can compare.

what_changed.title: Outreach re-promotes its Salesforce Headless / AgentExchange tie-in
what_changed.body: Low signal, amplification only. Oct 3 LinkedIn post (via TipRanks) re-ups the Sep 15 positioning: Outreach agents and Agentforce share live deal context and execute multi-step updates; Outreach is transactable on AgentExchange. No new product PR from any watchlist company Oct 3–5.

watch.title: October launch wave: Clay Sculpt (Oct 8) and Salesforce's October GAs
watch.body: Clay hosts Sculpt in San Francisco on Oct 8, its likely venue for new launches. Salesforce has Agent Optimizer and AI Skills in Agentforce Coworker slated for GA in October, with the Hunter outbound sales agent GA planned for November (restated in an Oct 5 regional release). Watch whether skills packaging and agent spend controls show up in pricing.

interpretation.fact: No watchlist product PR Oct 3–5. Cohere North 2 (Oct 5) adds token caps, autonomy policies, skills. OpenAI safety-report lead resigned (Oct 3). Aleph Alpha Kolibri available Oct 3. Google DiarizationLM-Gemma-4-E4B published Oct 4. Outreach Oct 3 LinkedIn post re-promotes Sep 15 AgentExchange news.
interpretation.note: Light interpretation: with competitors quiet, the useful signal is platform-level — metering and policy controls for agents are becoming standard admin features, which could raise buyer expectations for usage visibility in GTM agent tools. Do not treat the Outreach post as a new launch.
